notes: Books 100 shot, 50 jumped; stacks 100 a shot, 100 jumped. Basketballs 50 shot, 100 jumped; tanks 200 shot, 100 jumped. UFOs 100 or 200, all three 500 more.
E, J, O, T and Z: 1,000 plus 100 a second under par. Extra buggies at 10,000, 30,000 and 50,000.

victories: finish a section under the average time.
reach point Z of the beginner course.
shoot down a whole formation of three UFOs.
readme: Hall Patrol: Left and Right (or A and D) slow down and speed up, Up or W jumps, Space fires forward and up at once, P pauses.
claude: - Hall Patrol (owner 2026-10-26, locker order): authentic 1982 Moon Patrol rules and scoring (src/moonpatrol, 20 rule checks), her six-wheeled buggy patrols the school hallway between lockers, jumping holes in the floor, mousetraps and textbooks under bombing saucers; same amendment list.
